default goals lead customers to set more ambitious energy conservation goals and, as a consequence, to save more energy.
goal setting is an effective means of stimulating energy conservation, that defaults can be used to increase the number of people setting goals, and that defaults should be chosen carefully.
goal setting and defaults have a positive impact on energy conservation.

how information systems can be designed to motivate people to engage in energy conservation behavior.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we found evidence for goal setting to have a positive influence on energy saving behavior, and we found evidence for the influence of default settings on the choice of a goal.
we have shown the potential of goal-setting in the context of energy feedback systems.
we show the positive impact of a default goal on energy consumption, but only when the default goal is set at an optimal level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
goal setting and defaults are effective means of motivating energy conservation.
the design of energy conservation systems needs to take into account the interplay between goals and defaults, and that the effects of default goals can be moderated by feedback.
goal setting can be a useful instrument to increase energy conservation behavior.
